label: Measured end to end on assembled models (validation data only unless final_test_evaluation.json exists). Protection options in the table: none and scale_tmr (both implemented and measured).

protocol.clean: validation images 2048..4999 (disjoint from the Fisher images 0..2047)
protocol.fault: first 1000 validation images, 100 trials per distribution
protocol.distributions: weights_k8 (PRIMARY): 8 distinct weights over the whole assembled model, bit uniform over the weight's own encoding; scales_k1 (SECOND metric): 1 flip uniform over all stored scale bits (32 per unprotected INT layer, 3 x 32 per scale_tmr layer)

fault_shortlist_rule: non-dominated front (storage, predicted weight-fault drop, largest scale-word risk, measured clean drop) of the datatype-only assignments and of the protected assignments, each evenly thinned to half the size limit, plus the references

predicted_vs_measured.note: layer-additive estimates vs end-to-end measurements of the assembled models
